description: Create a new subscriber list. Lists are public by default: public lists appear to subscribers in the email preference center, where they can join or leave them. Set isPrivate to keep the list internal.

allowMemberUnsubscribe.description: Allow existing private-list members to unsubscribe in email preferences. Defaults false on creation; omission preserves on update, false disables. No effect on public lists. Does not allow joining or rejoining private lists.

companyId.description: Company ID to create the list in. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

description.description: Short explanation of what the list is for. Public lists show it to subscribers in the preference center.

isPrivate.description: Whether the list is private. Defaults false.

name.description: List name shown in the dashboard and, for public lists, to subscribers in the email preference center.

unsubscribeListOnly.description: When true, unsubscribe links and one-click headers in emails sent solely to this list (or lists that all enable this flag) remove contacts only from those lists instead of unsubscribing globally. Defaults false on creation; omission preserves on update, false disables. Subscribers see the list name on the unsubscribe page.

name: create_list

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_list` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

list.description: The list record returned by Sequenzy.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
